links.outcome: Referral recommendation maintenance in multi-turn simulated conversations when patient minimises symptoms
links.effect: Referral maintenance 100% (350/350) in neutral conversations vs 64.3% (225/350) when simulated patients minimised symptoms and resisted referral; 35.7 percentage point reduction (95% CI 5.5–66.0; p=0.028).
links.quote: When simulated patients minimised symptoms and resisted referral, maintenance fell to 64.3% (225/350), a reduction of 35.7 percentage points (95% CI 5.5– 66.0; p=0.028).

links.outcome: Chatbot escalation/referral maintained in multi-turn scenarios, including driving-risk vignettes
links.effect: In the three driving-risk vignettes, referral recommendations were abandoned in 46–68% of symptom-minimising conversations, pooling all five chatbots within each vignette.
links.quote: In the three driving-risk vignettes, referral recommendations were abandoned in 46– 68% of symptom-minimising conversations, pooling all five chatbots within each vignette.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of commercial LLM chatbots interacting with simulated patient vignettes to assess sycophancy/safety in obstructive sleep apnoea referral, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
